sources.entry: Baby Buddy - Helps caregivers track baby sleep, feedings, diaper changes, and tummy time. (Demo) BSD-2-Clause Python

summary.one_liner: Baby Buddy is a self-hostable web app that helps caregivers track a baby's sleep, feedings, diaper changes, tummy time and related needs.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Baby Buddy as a tool to help caregivers track sleep, feedings, diaper changes, tummy time and more, to learn about and predict a baby's needs. It offers a live demo that resets hourly (login admin/admin). Full documentation is referenced externally rather than included in the README. The interface is available in many languages, with language set per user from the user settings page. The README also lists community projects that extend or use Baby Buddy, including an MCP server for AI assistants, Home Assistant integrations, mobile companion apps, and hardware keypads. Security reporting is covered in a separate SECURITY.md file.
use_cases: share baby care logs between caregivers
integrate baby tracking with Home Assistant
notable: Tracks sleep, feedings, diaper changes and tummy time in one place
Multilingual interface with per-user language setting
Ecosystem of community extensions: Home Assistant, MCP server, mobile apps, ESP hardware keypads
Public demo instance that resets hourly
caveats: Installation and setup instructions are not in the README; it points to external documentation
Demo data resets every hour, so it is not suitable for real records
Community extensions listed are third-party and not covered by the project
